name: My Pond Game
idea: A frog hops between lily pads, collects golden coins and avoids drifting logs. One-minute rounds with three lives.
design: An illustrated moonlit pond, mint greens, warm gold coins and soft lavender menus. Expressive original frog artwork.
ux: Instant start, arrows or WASD on desktop, big touch controls on phones, clear instructions, pause, mute and one-tap restart.
